insertSlicer.label: Insert Slicer
insertSlicer.description: Add a slicer that filters the PivotTable by the selected field, or by a field picked from the list.

pivotStyleOptions.label: PivotTable Style Options
pivotStyleOptions.description: Choose which parts of the PivotTable style show.

pivotRefreshOptions.label: Refresh
pivotRefreshOptions.description: Read the PivotTable's source again and lay it out, or refresh everything the workbook reads.

pivotShowOptions.label: Show
pivotShowOptions.description: Choose which of the PivotTable's buttons and headers show.

pivotDrillIndicatorsToggle.label: Toggle PivotTable +/- Buttons
pivotDrillIndicatorsToggle.description: Show or hide the buttons that expand and collapse the PivotTable's items.

pivotFieldHeadersToggle.label: Toggle PivotTable Field Headers
pivotFieldHeadersToggle.description: Show or hide the captions and filter buttons over the PivotTable's row and column fields.

pivotRowHeadersToggle.label: Toggle PivotTable Row Headers
pivotRowHeadersToggle.description: Show special formatting for the first column of the PivotTable.

pivotColumnHeadersToggle.label: Toggle PivotTable Column Headers
pivotColumnHeadersToggle.description: Show special formatting for the first row of the PivotTable.

pivotBandedRowsToggle.label: Toggle PivotTable Banded Rows
pivotBandedRowsToggle.description: Show banded rows, even rows formatted differently from odd ones.

pivotBandedColumnsToggle.label: Toggle PivotTable Banded Columns
pivotBandedColumnsToggle.description: Show banded columns, even columns formatted differently from odd ones.
